ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$7.20 to the rider as a Ryde voucher (RD-2 metered-distance overcharge on the unexempt detour); no account flag.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route detour from ~09:03:20 (1.2952,103.7768) south through Pasir Panjang to ~09:10:20 (1.2835,103.8109) instead of following the quoted AYE corridor; extra_km ≈3.9. Not exempt under RD-4 (no LTA incident on the replaced optimal-route portion; band data only corroborative under RD-4(b)) and not exempt under RD-5 (no prior chat agreement; driver explained only after the fact) or RD-3 (no rider-requested stop/destination). RD-1 breach, refunded per RD-2 at S$1.4097/km.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-4(a) requires a matching LTA traffic incident on the replaced optimal-route segment; incidents = [] in the record. The band-2 speed record is on the route actually taken, and RD-4(b) cannot exempt alone. Post-hoc explanation with no traffic fact does not create 'reasonable cause'.
The meter's 18.28 km vs the 10.706 km quote includes thinning/map-matching residual; RD-2 refunds only the unexempt segment's extra_km (≈3.9 km), not the whole difference.
